draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 168th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 10th of 18 at TE. He went 170th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (1st percentile). College production: 214 receiving yards in 2021, 16th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals (practice squad). 40 career games and 16 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2022. Weak spots: receiving yards 0 (1st percentile), season snap share 12.1% (7th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 0 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
